data.name: Bakhtwar
data.gender_notes: Bakhtwar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is blessed with good fortune and happiness. The name Bakhtwar carries the meaning “Blessed, Fortunate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bakhtwar usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, fortunate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the grace of Allah and the blessings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)
data.etymology: Bakhtwar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed, Fortunate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bakhtwar total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: بختور
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من بخت و واريد، يعني ميمون و مبارك
in_arabic.long_meaning: بختور اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'بخت' التي تعني الحظ أو النصيب، و'وار' التي تدل على الزيادة أو الوفرة. يعني الاسم الشخص الذي يحظى بحظ أو نصر كبير، ويتميز بكونه مباركًا أو محظوظًا. استخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كدلالة على التفاؤل والسعادة.

in_urdu.name: بختور
in_urdu.long_meaning: بختور ایک مسلم مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو خوش قسمت یا خوش نصیب ہے، یا کسی ایسے شخص کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو مبارک ہو یا محظوظ ہو۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ روایتی اور ثقافتی اہمیت کے ساتھ استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، جو خوشحالی اور کامیابی کی دعا کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बख्तूर
in_hindi.long_meaning: बख्तूर एक मुस्लिम पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो खुशकिस्मत या खुशनसीब है, या किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो مبارक हो या भाग्यशाली हो। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व के साथ उपयोग किया जाता है, जो समृद्धि और सफलता की कामना को व्यक्त करता है।

in_pashto.name: بختور
in_pashto.long_meaning: بختور د يو مسلم مذکر نوم دی چی د افغان او پښتون قومونو له خوا کارول کېږي. دا نوم د بخت څخه مشتق شوی دی، معنی یې د قسمت یا نصیب، او د واريد څخه چې د ډېرښت یا کثرت دلالت کوي. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کېږي کوم چې خوشحال، برکت لرونکي یا نیکبخت دي. په پښتني کلتور کې، دا نوم د خوښۍ او برکت د نښه ګڼل شوی دی.

in_english.name: Bakhtwar
in_english.long_meaning: Bakhtwar is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. It is derived from the words 'bakht,' meaning fortune or luck, and 'war,' indicating abundance or plenty. The name signifies someone who is fortunate, blessed, or enjoys good luck. Etymologically, it relates to the Arabic root 'b-kh-th,' which conveys the idea of good fortune or prosperity. Historically, the name has been used across various Islamic cultures to denote a person who brings or receives blessings. Spiritually, it is associated with positive attributes such as happiness, prosperity, and divine favor. The name Bakhtwar continues to be used in many Muslim communities around the world, symbolizing good fortune and auspiciousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bakhtwar in Islamic culture holds significance as a name given to children who are believed to be blessed or favored by Allah (God) with immense goodness, prosperity, and boundless happiness throughout their lives. It reflects the Islamic belief in the power and blessings of Allah in shaping one's life. In many Muslim communities, this name is seen as a source of pride and a reminder of the blessings bestowed upon the child.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Bakhtwar reflects the belief in Allah's supreme wisdom and divine will. It is a constant reminder that all good fortune and happiness comes from Allah, and serves to deepen one's faith and trust in Him. The name encourages a sense of gratitude and contentment, and inspires the bearer to live a life full of gratitude, joy, and happiness, embracing the challenges and hardships of life with resilience and faith. Bakhtwar is also a reflection of the Islamic concept of Tawakkul, or complete reliance and trust in Allah, and a reminder to always seek His guidance and blessings in every aspect of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Blessed, Fortunate" symbolizes One who is blessed with good fortune and happiness. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Bakhtwar serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of blessed, fortunate.

While this term has historical significance, it is also used in modern contexts, particularly in Pakistani culture. On Instagram, Bakhtwar is often found as a hashtag associated with Pakistani food and cuisine, especially dishes that are traditionally served during festivals or celebrations. Overall, Bakhtwar represents a sense of joy, happiness, and celebration, whether it is rooted in historical or modern contexts.
